# Cecilia Ashdown

deceased

## Overview

- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. HECTOR TWISS MAKES A CALL P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026)</sub>
- **Family:** [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) (child), [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) (spouse), [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) (child)

## Appearance

Cecilia Ashdown has dusky, regal hair, which she has worn adorned with sweet-smelling crimson June roses. She also possesses dark-blue eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. HECTOR TWISS MAKES A CALL P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018)_

## Personality

Cecilia Ashdown is described as a petite, dark-haired individual who was full of life. She possessed skill in needlework, taking great pride in crafting items such as a coverlet for her guest room.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P95](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0095), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007)_

## History

Before her death, Cecilia Ashdown crafted hemstitched sheets and needleworked coverlets for her guest room. Facing her impending departure, she hugged her infant daughter [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) to her chest and implored her husband John to look after the child well, as well as asking him to show great thoughtfulness toward [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P95](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0095), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ## Relationships

### [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-ashdown--ida-ashdown.md)

Cecilia Ashdown is the mother of [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md). [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) is among the local children at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) who spend time with [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) and are entertained by her stories and tricks.

### [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-ashdown--john-ashdown.md)

Cecilia Ashdown was married to [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) prior to her death. Following her passing, John reflected on his feelings for her while contemplating a second marriage and deciding to propose to [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).

### [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-ashdown--rupert.md)

Cecilia Ashdown is the mother of [Rupert](../character/rupert.md). [Rupert](../character/rupert.md) is one of the local [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) children who spends time listening to Mary Stubbs's ghost tales and captivating stories.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P9](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0009), +2 more_
